title: Random Name Tables (Setting + Freebie)
author: NaldoDrinan
content_html:
I would ask "what's in a name" but I used that one already - instead, I can just say that I received a few requests for more BREAK!! style names, so I thought these random tables might be helpful.
 
There are a few ways you can use these tables
  • You can use them to name a random GMC on the spot, if needed.
  • They can provide a jumping off point or inspiration for PC or GMC creation
  • When coming up with the key players of a Saga, you might roll on a few of these and run with what you get.
Whatever you do use these for, all tables use a d20, as always. Also note, that if an individual was adopted and raised by a species other than their own (for example, a Tenebrate with a Chib parent) they will probably use one of their adopted parents table over their own.
 
Random Name Table
1-5: Native Human Name
6-7: Chib Name
8-10: Tenebrate Name
11-13: Rai-Neko Name
14-15: Promethean Name
16: Gruun Name
17: Goblin Name
18: Dwarf Name
19: Elf Name
20: Bio-Mechanoid Name
